# peakhour_rp_origin_config (Resource)

Manages RP origin behavior settings for a domain (distinct from origin pools).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "peakhour_rp_origin_config" "example" {
  domain   = "example.com"
  ssl_mode = "strict"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Domain name.

### Optional

- `origin_downtime` (Number) Origin downtime threshold. Set to null to clear.
- `origin_errors_conn_refused` (Number) Connection refused error threshold. Set to null to clear.
- `origin_errors_conn_reset` (Number) Connection reset error threshold. Set to null to clear.
- `origin_errors_conn_timeout` (Number) Connection timeout error threshold. Set to null to clear.
- `origin_errors_response_timeout` (Number) Response timeout error threshold. Set to null to clear.
- `origin_errors_server_error` (Number) 5xx error threshold. Set to null to clear.
- `origin_request_headers` (Attributes) Origin request header options. Set to null to clear. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--origin_request_headers))
- `ssl_mode` (String) Origin SSL mode (spec enum: none, https, https-client, passthrough). Set to null to clear.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) RP origin config identifier (domain/rp_origin_config).

<a id="nestedatt--origin_request_headers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `origin_request_headers`

Optional:

- `blocklists` (Boolean) Forward blocklist headers to origin. Set to null to clear.
- `client_proxy` (Boolean) Forward client proxy headers to origin. Set to null to clear.
- `geoip` (Boolean) Forward GeoIP headers to origin. Set to null to clear.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import peakhour_rp_origin_config.example example.com
```
